p.t: Threads of Time: Kenyah Stories Untold
p.d: The series traces the rich heritage of the Kenyah people from their origins in the Usun Apau highlands. The series explores their journey to find a home, the communal life in longhouses, and the traditions that shape their identity. It highlights intricate crafts like beading and carving, vibrant music and dance, and the breathtaking natural beauty of Usun Apau, from hidden waterfalls to signature Kenyah cuisine.

Nature is a tempestuous beast, capable of destruction on a level so devastating and claimed the lives of millions. In recent years, these extreme weather events have become more and more commonplace. Using incredible archive and astonishing user-generated footage of some of the most extraordinary weather the planet has ever seen, we'll relive these weather spectacles in astonishing minute by minute detail, revealing very personal stories of people who have captured the entire event on camera.

Anything and everything can happen IN OUR HOUSE. A magical and colorful house with equally quirky occupants. ALVIN loves to read and always has the answers to any problems. SEAN, the resident joker, is affable with his misadventures. The rose among the thorns, K-NA proves herself a strong independent lady who does not need to wait for a knight in shining armour. Together, they are joined by MEX and BO, the two monsters who love to have fun. Innovative segments with a deep focus and awareness are all part of the entertaining and engaging new format. IN OUR HOUSE is full of surprises and is more interactive and energetic than you have ever seen before. In an entertaining mix of song, dance, music and drama, join the wacky hosts as they introduce the LETTERS AND NUMBERS OF THE DAY and the adventures that they encounter. Follow them through the SHOCKADELIC DOOR, which will lead them to interesting and unexpected places. Look out through the WINDOW to learn and see more things than you could ever imagine. And the MAGIC BOX brings to you unexpected gifts that can only be culled by your imagination. IN OUR HOUSE opens its doors to a host of characters from the fairy tales and nursery rhymes. Learn more about these characters and you would be surprised with the new and unexpected twists that the characters reveal in the show. The BIG BAD WOLF is simply a misunderstood wolf. GOLDILOCKS visits with a bowl of porridge but got distracted by the hosts' red cherries and strawberries. LITTLE BO BEEP was lost looking for her sheep that ran away but ended up IN OUR HOUSE. And the PRINCESS WITH THE PEA is on the search for her missing pre-nuptial gifts. These and many other colourful characters will pay a visit IN OUR HOUSE for some fun and game.

Ma Dabao, a seemingly wise and kind e-commerce tycoon, plagiarized his son, Deming’s concept of a Smart Juice Cup (AI Cup) at a press conference in order to defeat him. When he finds out his brother Ma Xiaobao colluded with Guo Jiacheng, a logistics company owner to sell fake products for personal profit, he insists on punishing Xiaobao according to the law relentlessly, but never did he expect this to land himself as an unjustly ghost living in the AI Cup. She Xiaoqian, is a loyal user of the online shopping platform, Wa Dao Bao, and more so, a number 1 fan of Dabao! Her dream is to work alongside with Ma Dabao, and become a charming workplace figure like her idol! However, when Xiaoqian accidentally bought the AI Cup with the trapped ghost of Dabao online, she assumes he is just a cheeky wild ghost pretending to be Ma Dabao! After all, Xiaobao has deliberately concealed Dabao’s death, so he has no choice but to pretend to be an elf and an ill-fated ghost to coax Xiaoqian to help him trace the cause of his death, because all he could remember is being attacked and died inexplicably. Guo Renjie, heir of a logistics company has a crush on Xiaoqian, and is always at her disposal. Both Renjie and Deming do not get work recognition from their fathers and therefore could relate well to each other. The two decided to collaborate to contend with “Wa Dao Bao”! Deming cares about Xiaoqian, who is unaware that she is actually the push factor for Deming to set up the GoReach shopping platform! She always inspires him with a solution whenever he encounters a problem. Xiaoqian finally believes that Ghost Dabao is the real Ma Dabao! She decides to proactively help Dabao investigate the cause of his death, which leads her into a series of crisis situations. The AI Cup was later damaged and Xiaoqian could no longer able to see Dabao. It turns out that other than Xiaobao, Jiacheng and Deming were also involved in Dabao's death! When Xiaoqian can finally see Dabao again, he changed his stand and now wants her to stop investigating the cause of his death. Renjie found out who the real murderer is but he went missing before he could tell Xiaoqian. Deming is being suspected of hiding Renjie. Hainanese Chicken Rice is a local national delicacy which was brought along by Hainanese immigrants in early years. This episode, host Yi Fong and Chef Ivan visit famous local chicken rice stalls to learn about the recipe, ingredients and secrets for this dish and attempt to recreate the old taste. 海南鸡饭是国人热爱的国民美食，海南人过番南来后,鸡饭开始在本地飘香。这一集节目里主持人怡凤和年轻厨师杨应晖一起拜会本地老字号的海南鸡饭业者，了解古早味的做法，用料和秘诀，还原和示范古早味的海南鸡饭。

Xu Long Bin (Romeo Tan) is a reservist officer who saved Chen Jin Bao’s (Pierre Png) life during a military exercise. Instead of being grateful, Jin Bao blames Long Bin for his damaged car. From then, the duo never see eye to eye. Lu Jun Guang (Desmond Tan) becomes their mediator and the three men eventually became friends. Jun Guang is in love with Shen Yi Xuan (Paige Chua), who cannot get over the memory of her dead boyfriend. While Bai Jin Yu (Felicia Chin), Jun Guang’s childhood friend, is always at his side through thick and thin. New recruit Yao Wei Guo (Shane Pow) dislikes Yang Xian Feng (Ricky Koh) and constantly picks on him. But Xian Feng proves himself to be a kind and compassionate buddy, and they eventually become good friends. Their friendship is tested when they fall in love with the same girl. Long Bin, Jun Guang and Jin Bao are patrolling a restricted military area when they encounter a terrorist attack. Will they be able to put their military skills to good use and stop the terrorist attack? 许龙斌（陈罗密欧）是一名战备军官，在一次的军习中搭救了陈金保（方展发）。对方不但不领情，还嫌龙斌搞砸了他的宝贝名车，两人因此冤家路窄。陆俊光（陈泂江）渐渐地帮他们解除了彼此间的芥蒂，三人最终变成了推心置腹的好友。俊光爱上了沈宜萱（蔡琦慧）并成为她的男友，但是第三者的介入造成了复杂的三角恋。然而，从小与俊光青梅竹马的白静雨（陈凤玲）却始终默默地守候在他身边。姚卫国（包勋评）起初对杨先锋（许瑞奇）感到不屑，还常常处处为难他。先锋不与他计较，给予协助与照顾，卫国因此对先锋有所改观，最后两人还成为好兄弟。但是，两人却同时爱上同一个女孩。这一天，龙斌、俊光、金保正在巡逻军事重区，正好遇到恐怖分子的攻击。受过军训的他们是否能学以致用，及时解除危机，防止一场浩劫的发生？

In this returning season of FINDING, six heartfelt reunions honour people who left a lasting mark. Nearly 40 years after Basic Military Training, Minister Ong Ye Kung searches for his BMT buddy Eric, while actor-host Noah Yap reunites with Ma’am Haiyan, the mentor who believed in him and supported his family through difficult times. Actor Elvin Ng and his mother travel to Indonesia to surprise Jumi, the domestic helper who became their pillar of strength, while 23-year-old Leticia journeys to Central Java to thank Auntie Mas, who helped raise her for 12 years. Dino Isaac reconnects with the Primary 3 teacher whose kindness gave him hope after a traumatic childhood, while radio DJ Gerald Koh and conservation educator John Chua surprise the teachers who inspired and guided them. Together, these emotional journeys celebrate friendship, gratitude and the lasting impact of those who quietly shape lives.

Twenty-five years after 9/11, this gripping documentary tells the untold story of the 170 people trapped inside Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant on the top floors of the World Trade Center’s North Tower. Through never-before-seen family archives, emergency calls and emotional interviews with survivors, the film follows the final hour of those stranded above the impact zone with no means of escape.At the heart of the story is Jupiter Yambem, an Indian immigrant and banquet manager at the restaurant. Just a week earlier, he had switched to the morning shift so he could spend more time with his young son, a decision that placed him at work on that fateful day. From the streets of Manhattan to the Loktak Lake of Manipur, India, the film traces the unknown devastation of 9/11 across continents, forever changing families, communities and lives thousands of miles away.
News and views from around the region, delivered with uniquely Asian perspectives.

By Your Side follows families caring for loved ones with rare diseases, special needs, disabilities and the challenges of ageing. Parents of children with West syndrome and Harlequin ichthyosis navigate seizures, intensive treatments and daily care while celebrating every small achievement. The series also follows families facing ALS and dementia, where spouses and children provide constant care as their loved ones gradually lose their independence. Across generations, these caregivers sacrifice careers, time and personal freedom, yet find strength in love and companionship. Their stories celebrate resilience, acceptance and the preciousness of simply being by someone's side.
